name: When should I hire a professional for bathroom door frame repairs?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a professional for bathroom door frame repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional if the door rubs hard against the jamb, fails to latch, or shows soft, discolored spots along the bottom wood trim. Ignoring a misaligned frame can strain the door hinges and damage surrounding drywall or tile over time. Furthermore, if you press on the base of the frame and the wood feels spongy or gives off a musty odor, moisture has likely penetrated the assembly. Addressing these signs early prevents water from traveling into the subfloor or interior wall cavities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional if the frame feels soft or spongy, the door no longer latches or clears the floor, or you notice persistent moisture damage near the base.
